infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Marigold uses the camera so you can take bump photos for your private pregnancy journal. Photos stay on your phone.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Marigold lets you choose photos from your library for your private pregnancy journal. Photos stay on your phone.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Marigold can save your bump collage to your photo library when you ask it to.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Marigold uses Face ID to unlock the app so your pregnancy journal stays private.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Marigold only uses the microphone if you record a video with the camera. It never records audio on its own.
